_read_me: Spoilers. The GM console loads this for gm and admin sign-ins only. Edit the lines freely. It is a list, not a schedule: since 23 Sep the hints have no times against them and the game master gives one when the room needs one. Wording follows The Last Guest Guide (GM / Facilitator Flow Deck), which asks for the smallest nudge that moves players forward — never name Natalie before they have connected the evidence. Anything with "optional": true sits under 'If they are still stuck' at the bottom of the list.

hints.title: The clock
hints.line: Is there anything in the photo that gives you a second time?

hints.title: The window
hints.line: If the reaction takes 10 to 20 minutes, what time did Kai eat?

hints.title: Opportunity
hints.line: Who was alone with the desserts at a time inside that window?

hints.title: Motive
hints.line: Why would tonight matter more than tomorrow morning?

hints.title: Method
hints.line: Why are there two desserts, and why is one labelled NUT FREE?

reset: Return Kai to the starting position.
Reset both dessert plates: the nut dessert at Kai's seat, the NUT FREE one back where it starts.
Replace the receipt, the allergy card, the notebook, the draft will, the solicitor letter and the empty EpiPen case.
Re-place the suspect cards and the suspect statements.
Reset the camera stills and the timeline materials.
Set the lock box back to 0000 — never leave it on 1012, it gives the answer away.
Both desk devices back to the phone's home screen — the file's own reset, top-left of its lock screen.
Check the off-limits areas are still marked and every prop players can reach is safe.
